data.one_liner: A highly customizable gesture-unlocking widget for Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a grid-based gesture lock widget where users can draw patterns to unlock or authenticate. Supports custom items for normal, selected, error, and arrow states, as well as line color adjustments, answer validation, and loose point matching.
use_when: You need a gesture unlock or pattern confirmation screen in your app.
You require high customization of the gesture nodes, arrows, and lines.
avoid_when: You need standard biometric authentication (Face ID / Fingerprint) instead of a drawn pattern.
strengths: Highly customizable appearance for normal, selected, and error states.
Supports answer validation, minimum length constraints, and custom arrow indicators.
weaknesses: Limited to gesture lock UI use cases.
Does not include built-in persistent storage for the secret pattern.
